title: Windows Money
summary: A Windows-98-styled, desktop-in-the-browser AI trading dashboard wired to a real broker API and a multi-agent LLM backend.
role: Sole engineer — full-stack frontend plus the AI agent and auto-trading backend.
highlights: Multi-agent LLM system that produces trading signals from market data.
Real broker integration (InvertirOnline) with an auto-rebalancer and backtesting engine.
Draggable/resizable Win98 window manager built with 98.css, fully tested.
description: Windows Money reframes an algorithmic trading workstation as a nostalgic desktop OS. Each capability — portfolio, live market data, quick-trade, auto-trader, backtesting — is its own draggable window. Under the hood it wires a multi-agent LLM pipeline to a real Argentine broker API, turning model signals into executable, backtestable rebalancing actions.

title: Reema
summary: A deployed SaaS that adds an embeddable "listen to this article" audio player to blogs and digital media, powered by a multi-provider TTS pipeline.
role: Sole engineer across a multi-service product — dashboard, marketing site, synthesizer, and embeddable player.
highlights: Multi-provider TTS synthesizer (Google, ElevenLabs, Azure) with HTML→SSML conversion and caching.
Customer dashboard with player customization, domains, usage metrics, and billing.
Statically-generated embeddable player served in an iframe with metrics beaconing.
description: Reema is a production SaaS built as several coordinated services: an admin dashboard where customers configure players, a TTS synthesizer that extracts article text and renders natural speech across multiple providers with caching, and a statically-generated embeddable widget. It is the clearest example of a full AI-powered product shipped end-to-end.

title: SplitBerlin
summary: A deployed multi-tenant SaaS that runs a two-stage AI pipeline to pull structured data out of legal contracts for small German law firms.
role: Sole engineer — full-stack product, from the multi-tenant data model to the AI extraction pipeline.
highlights: Two-stage AI pipeline — GPT-4o-mini classifies the uploaded contract's type, then DeepSeek R1 extracts type-specific structured fields, streamed live to a 4-step upload wizard.
Multi-tenant data model with 5 roles (owner to viewer) and permission checks that scope every contract, task, and alert query to the caller's organization.
AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for sensitive contract fields (summary, conditions, and the stored file itself).
Deadline-alert and task system with email invitations, on a bilingual (DE/EN) landing page.
description: SplitBerlin (product name Paragraph+) is a deployed SaaS that helps small German law firms manage contracts with AI assistance. Uploaded PDFs and DOCX files run through a two-stage pipeline — a classifier routes the document to a type-specific extractor whose output is schema-validated — surfacing structured data in a contract editor alongside deadline alerts, role-based multi-tenancy, and encryption at rest for sensitive fields.

title: Parallax 360 Tour
summary: A depth-aware 360° panorama viewer that reconstructs real geometric parallax from a single equirectangular photo via an offline ML pipeline.
role: Sole engineer — the three.js viewer, the Python depth/inpainting pipeline, and the scene-generation tooling.
highlights: Chains Depth-Anything-3 (falling back to Depth-Anything-V2, then MiDaS, then a synthetic gradient) to estimate per-pixel depth from a single panorama.

Slices the depth map into foreground/background layers, inpaints the disoccluded background with LaMa, and renders each layer as a concentric three.js sphere displaced by depth — real geometric parallax rather than a shader trick.

Interactive CLI wizard (new_scene.py) that detects installed ML backends, picks a quality preset, runs the full pipeline, and patches the scene registry with automatic TypeScript validation and rollback on failure.
Optional SAM 2 object-snap pass that aligns depth-layer boundaries with object silhouettes.
description: Parallax 360 Tour solves the hard part of a parallax-capable 360° viewer: reconstructing enough scene geometry from a single equirectangular photograph for the browser to have something to displace. An offline Python pipeline — depth estimation, layer slicing, background inpainting — produces a Layered Depth Image that a thin three.js runtime renders as nested, depth-displaced spheres, so a small cursor movement produces genuine geometric parallax, including seeing behind foreground objects.

title: Pegala
summary: An AI job-search platform for the Argentine market — a resume-tailoring product paired with a companion pipeline that mines job-search communities for product ideas.
role: Sole engineer — product localization, the waitlist landing, and the companion research pipeline.
highlights: Full resume-tailoring application with a FastAPI/LiteLLM backend — document parsing, diff-based resume tailoring against a job description, cover-letter/outreach generation, and PDF rendering via headless Chromium.
Waitlist landing (Next.js, Neon Postgres) collecting early signups ahead of the Argentina-market launch.

reddit-idea-miner — a companion daily pipeline that scans job-search subreddits and Hacker News, filters for engagement, and uses an LLM to turn raw posts into actionable, localized product-idea digests emailed to guide the roadmap.
Feedback loop (miner.mark) that records which mined ideas were implemented, discarded, or interesting, so future digests sharpen over time.
disclosure: The core is built on the open-source Resume Matcher project.
description: Pegala is a waitlist-stage AI job-search platform for the Argentine market. Behind the public landing sits the full product — forked from the open-source Resume Matcher and adapted for the local market — plus reddit-idea-miner, a standalone opportunity-mining module that continuously scans job-search communities for pain points and mails back structured, LLM-analyzed ideas to steer what gets built next.

title: Null Rev
summary: An experimental creative-technologist studio brand — a self-mocking "zero revenue" persona wrapped around genuinely engineered audio and visual effects.
role: Sole engineer — full brand site, including the Web Audio sound design and the CRT/glitch effect system.
highlights: Generative Web Audio engine (oscillators, filters, gain nodes) driving a mechanical "relay click" UI sound behind a dedicated on/off toggle.
CRT-terminal effect system — phosphor-green scanlines, chromatic-aberration hover states, and a canvas-rendered, animated 35mm film-grain overlay.
Glitch container component that randomly slices and offsets content for a configurable-intensity screen-tear effect.
A "pivot generator" easter egg that recombines buzzwords into a fake startup pitch on click, and every effect above respects prefers-reduced-motion.
description: Null Rev is an experimental creative-technologist studio brand, built as a live showcase for interaction craft. The copy plays up a self-aware "zero revenue" persona, but the effects underneath are real engineering: a generative Web Audio sound design, a CRT/phosphor terminal aesthetic with canvas-based film grain and glitch slicing, and scroll-linked motion — all gated behind a reduced-motion fallback that renders every effect's final state instantly.

title: Irem Cengiz — Personal Website
summary: A deployed personal site for a Berlin-based legal counsel, paired with a homegrown, password-protected CMS that lets her edit copy and SEO at runtime.
role: Sole engineer — full-stack build of the public site and the bespoke admin/CMS.
highlights: Homegrown CMS — a password-protected /admin editor backed by Vercel Blob storage, with Zod-validated content and JWT sessions (bcrypt + jose), so the client can update copy and SEO without a deploy.
Trilingual site (EN/DE/TR) with a locale provider that persists the visitor's choice, syncs across tabs, and falls back to browser language.
Parallax hero portrait and scroll-triggered entrance animations built with GSAP.
Server-action contact form (Resend) with honeypot spam protection and per-locale validation.
description: A single-page personal site for Irem Cengiz, a Berlin-based legal counsel for technology startups and boards. Beyond the public-facing page — trilingual, animated, SEO-tuned — the project includes a bespoke admin editor: a password-protected dashboard that lets her rewrite every section's copy and SEO metadata at runtime, stored in Vercel Blob and validated against the same schema the public site renders from.

title: Studio 361°
summary: A deployed marketing site for a product design studio, built around a scroll-scrubbed "how we work" sequence and a token-driven motion system with a full reduced-motion fallback.
role: Sole engineer — full-stack implementation of the site and its motion design system for the client.
highlights: Scroll-scrubbed process section — 4 steps and their connecting circles progress via useScroll/useTransform as the visitor scrolls, not on a timer.
Motion system built on shared duration/easing/stagger tokens, mirrored in CSS custom properties so JS- and CSS-driven animation stay in sync.
A useReducedMotionPref() hook where every animated component renders its final state instantly under reduced motion, with a dev-only toggle to test the fallback.
Custom event tracking (Vercel Web Analytics) on every CTA and card via a shared tracked-link component.
description: Studio 361° is the marketing site for a remote-first digital product studio. The build centers on a layered motion system — scroll-triggered section reveals, a scroll-scrubbed "how we work" sequence, and CSS micro-interactions sharing one set of duration/easing tokens — engineered from the start with a strict reduced-motion fallback rather than bolted on afterward.

title: HOMETECH
summary: A deployed marketing site and self-serve budget configurator for a Buenos Aires modular-home builder, pairing a static product catalog with a Strapi-backed land-plot catalog and a 5-step "asistente".
role: Sole engineer — extended a v0-generated marketing scaffold into a real product, building the budget wizard, the pricing/financing logic, the Strapi CMS integration, lead capture, and the SEO/structured-data layer.
highlights: Five-step budget "asistente" (model → lot → distance & shipping → payment → summary) where all pricing and financing math lives in one client hook.
Lead capture without a backend — each configured budget gets an HT-XXXXXX id and generates a pre-filled WhatsApp message and mailto.
Two catalogs from two sources — house models are static and version-controlled in code, while land plots are served from a standalone Strapi 5 CMS through a credential-safe server route.
Resilient by design — every Strapi failure path degrades to an empty catalog instead of crashing.
disclosure: Scaffolded from a v0.app generation, then extended by hand into the configurator, CMS integration, and lead flow.
description: HOMETECH is the marketing site and budget configurator for a modular-home builder serving the greater Buenos Aires area (a brand of IDERO). Beyond the landing page sits a five-step "asistente" that walks a visitor from picking a house model through land, shipping distance, and financing to a priced-out summary — the pricing and per-bank installment math running client-side in a single hook. The house catalog is static and lives in code; the land-plot catalog is dynamic, fetched from a standalone Strapi CMS through a credential-safe server route that gracefully degrades to an empty list. Each budget is stamped with an HT-XXXXXX id and turned into a pre-filled WhatsApp or email message.
